description: This file defines the CustomerService interface, which provides methods for customer-related operations such as retrieval, listing, saving, and address lookup within the sales management system.

classes.name: CustomerService
classes.description: An interface extending generic entity service, defining customer-related operations such as retrieval by name, store, nickname, saving/updating, listing with criteria, and address lookup.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customers matching the given first name.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all customers associated with the specified merchant store.

methods.name: getByNick
methods.description: Retrieves a customer based on their nickname.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new customer or updates an existing one; throws ServiceException on failure.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists customers associated with a store, filtered by specified criteria.

methods.name: getByNick
methods.description: Retrieves a customer by nickname within a specific store identified by store ID.

methods.name: getCustomerAddress
methods.description: Returns the customer's address based on the client's IP address, utilizing geo-location services; may throw ServiceException.
